unitTitle: The Loch Ness Monster — Episode 2: The Wrong Photograph
scanNote:
47-BET. Loch Ness hikoyasining 2-epizodiga mashqlar.

5-mashqda 6 ta raqamlangan yuz surati bor. Skaner bilan tekshirildi, HAMMASI TO'G'RI:
  a surprised (kitobda berilgan — ko'zoynakli kal erkak, og'zi ochiq), b angry (o'sha erkak, qoshi chimirilgan), c happy (qora sochli erkak, jilmayadi), d scared (sarg'ish sochli ayol, ko'zi katta ochilgan), e tired (ayol, peshonasiga qo'l qo'ygan), f upset (ayol, xafa).

  ⚠ Ro'yxatda 6 ta sifat va 6 ta rasm — har biri bir martadan.

7-MAShQNING TO'RT XATOSI 46-betdagi komiks bilan TASDIQLANDI:
  1) 'by bus' → aslida 'AT THE TRAIN STATION' yozilgan, ya'ni POYEZD
  2) 'The monster is small' → Devid telefonda 'It's HUGE!' deydi
  3) 'tells him about the accident' → aslida MAXLUQ va SURATLAR haqida aytadi
  4) 'photographs of David's face' → Mayk 'blonde hair and big blue eyes' deydi, ya'ni SANDRAning yuzi

Qolgan mashqlar ham TO'G'RI: 1-mashq (5 javob), 2-mashq (S, D, D, M), 3-mashq (warm, short, big), 4-mashq (No/No/Yes/No), 6a (7 buyruq + 6 savol), 8-mashq (long, lake, dark, monster, trees, visit).

⚠ GEOGRAFIK ANIQLIK TEKShIRILDI: 8-mashq matnida Loch Ness 'twenty-three miles long and one mile wide' deyilgan — haqiqiy Loch Ness taxminan 37 km (23 milya) uzunlikda va 1,5 km (1 milya) kenglikda. TO'G'RI.
  'Urquhart Castle' ham to'g'ri yozilgan (talaffuzi taxminan 'ORkart').

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the pictures on p. 46 and answer the questions.
exercises.instructionUz: 46-betdagi rasmlarga qarang va savollarga javob bering.
exercises.explanationUz:
Javoblarni komiks rasmlaridan toping.
To'liq gap bilan javob berishga harakat qiling.

items.textEn: 1  Where is Sandra in the first picture?
items.whyUz:
Sandra qayiqdan tushib, Loch Ness ko'lining suviga tushib qolgan.
'in the water' — suv ICHIDA → IN.

Devid: 'Just take my hand!' — u Sandrani qutqaradi.
'to save' = qutqarmoq. Birlik ega → saveS.

items.textEn: 3  How does Sandra feel in the third picture?
items.whyUz:
Sandra: 'Brrr! I'm cold.' — u sovqotgan.
'feel' + sifat: She feels cold ('feels coldly' XATO).

items.answer: The photographs are in the envelope.
items.whyUz: Devid: 'They're right here in this envelope!'

items.textEn: 5  Whose face is it in the photographs?
items.hintUz: Mayk sariq soch va ko'k ko'z haqida gapiradi
items.whyUz:
Mayk: 'the monster has got blonde hair and big blue eyes' — bu Sandra.
Oxirgi rasmda ham Sandraning surati ko'rinadi.
'Whose' = kimniki → javobda egalik: Sandra'S face.

exercises.instructionEn: Listen to the episode. Who says the following? Write D for David, S for Sandra or M for Mike.
exercises.instructionUz: Epizodni tinglang. Quyidagilarni kim aytadi? Devid uchun D, Sandra uchun S, Mayk uchun M yozing.
exercises.explanationUz:
Javoblarni 46-betdagi komiksdan ham topish mumkin —
har bir gap qaysi qahramonning nutq pufakchasida ekaniga qarang.

QAHRAMONLAR:
  D = David  (fotograf, sariq kurtkada)
  S = Sandra (jurnalist, sariq sochli)
  M = Mike   (muharrir, Londonda)

items.whyUz: SANDRA aytadi — u suvga tushib qolgan va qo'rqyapti.
DEVID aytadi — u Sandraga qo'lini uzatadi.
DEVID aytadi — Sandra maxluq qayerdaligini so'raganida.
MAYK aytadi — u konvertdan Sandraning suratini ko'rganda.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the opposites: big, short, or warm.
exercises.instructionUz: Qarama-qarshi so'zlarni qo'ying: big, short yoki warm.
exercises.explanationUz:
'≠' belgisi QARAMA-QARSHI ma'noni bildiradi.

RO'YXAT: big, short, warm

Har bir juftlik 46-betdagi hikoyadan olingan:
  cold  — 'The water's cold'
  long  — 'a long neck'
  small — 'a small head'

items.whyUz:
cold (sovuq) ↔ warm (iliq).
DIQQAT: 'hot' (issiq) ham aksi, lekin ro'yxatda 'warm' bor.

long (uzun) ↔ short (kalta).
Maxluqning bo'yni UZUN, dumi esa kalta bo'lardi.

small (kichik) ↔ big (katta).
Maxluqning boshi KICHIK, o'zi esa juda katta (huge).

exercises.instructionEn: Read the episode and mark the correct sentences with Yes and the incorrect ones with No. Then, make sentences as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Epizodni o'qing va to'g'ri gaplarni Yes, noto'g'rilarini No deb belgilang. So'ng namunadagidek gaplar tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  1  The monster has got a big head. ...No...
     No, it hasn't. The monster has got a small head.

JAVOB TUZILISHI:
  1) Yes / No
  2) Qisqa javob: Yes, it is / No, it isn't
                  Yes, it has / No, it hasn't
  3) TO'G'RI ma'lumotni ayting.

QAYSI QISQA JAVOB?
  Gap 'has got' bilan bo'lsa → it has / it hasn't
  Gap 'is' bilan bo'lsa      → it is  / it isn't

items.textEn: 1  The monster has got a big head.
items.answer: No, it hasn't. The monster has got a small head.
items.whyUz: Kitobda BERILGAN namuna. Devid: 'It's got a long neck and a SMALL head.'

items.answer: No, it isn't. The water is cold.
items.whyUz:
Sandra: 'The water's COLD and I'm scared!'
'is' bilan gap → qisqa javob 'it isn't'.

TO'G'RI. Devid: 'we've got photos of NESSIE'.
Mayk ham: 'the photographs of Nessie'.

items.textEn: 4  The monster has got a short neck.
items.answer: No, it hasn't. The monster has got a long neck.
items.whyUz:
Devid: 'It's got a LONG neck and a small head.'
'has got' bilan gap → qisqa javob 'it hasn't'.

exercises.instructionEn: The adjectives in the list describe how each person feels. Label the pictures with the correct adjectives. Then, say how David, Sandra and Mike feel in each picture.
exercises.instructionUz: Ro'yxatdagi sifatlar har bir odamning kayfiyatini bildiradi. Rasmlarni to'g'ri sifat bilan belgilang. So'ng har rasmda Devid, Sandra va Mayk o'zini qanday his qilishini ayting.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT: scared, surprised, tired, angry, happy, upset

  scared ..... qo'rqqan
  surprised .. hayron
  tired ...... charchagan
  angry ...... jahli chiqqan
  happy ...... xursand
  upset ...... xafa, asabiylashgan

KITOBDA BERILGAN: a — surprised (Mike is surprised.)

RASMLARDAGI ODAMLAR:
  a, b — Mayk (keksa, ko'zoynakli)
  c    — Devid (yosh, qora sochli)
  d, e, f — Sandra (sariq sochli, qizil kurtkada)

YUZ IFODASINI QANDAY O'QIYSIZ:
  og'iz ochiq + qosh ko'tarilgan  → surprised
  qosh qovoq + tish ko'rinadi     → angry
  tabassum                        → happy
  ko'z katta ochilgan + og'iz 'O' → scared
  ko'z yumilgan + qo'l peshanada  → tired
  yuz burishgan, tish qisilgan    → upset

items.whyUz: Kitobda BERILGAN: Mike is surprised. Og'zi ochiq, qoshi ko'tarilgan.

b-rasmda Maykning qoshlari qovoq solgan va tishlari ko'rinadi → ANGRY.
U noto'g'ri suratlarni ko'rib jahli chiqadi.

c-rasmda Devid tabassum qilyapti → HAPPY.
U Nessining suratini olganiga ishonib xursand.

items.hintUz: Sandra — ko'zi katta ochilgan, og'zi ochiq
items.whyUz:
d-rasmda Sandraning ko'zlari katta ochilgan, og'zi 'O' shaklida → SCARED.
Bu — suvga tushgan paytdagi ifodasi.

e-rasmda Sandraning ko'zlari yumilgan, qo'li peshanasida → TIRED.
Suvdan chiqqandan keyin charchagan.

f-rasmda Sandraning yuzi burishgan → UPSET.
Suratlar noto'g'ri chiqqanidan xafa.

exercises.instructionEn: Then, say how David, Sandra and Mike feel in each picture.
exercises.instructionUz: So'ng har bir rasmda Devid, Sandra va Mayk o'zini qanday his qilishini ayting.
exercises.explanationUz:
QOLIP: Ism + IS + sifat.
Kitobdagi namuna: Mike is surprised.

DIQQAT: bu sifatlar '-ed' bilan tugaydi va ODAMning
his-tuyg'usini bildiradi. Ular 'be' fe'li bilan keladi.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the episode and find seven imperatives and six questions.
exercises.instructionUz: Epizodni o'qing va yettita buyruq gap hamda oltita savol toping.
exercises.explanationUz:
BUYRUQ GAP (imperative):
  Egasi YO'Q, fe'l asos shaklida boshlanadi.
  Inkori: DON'T + fe'l.
  Vazifasi: buyruq, iltimos, maslahat, ogohlantirish.

SAVOL (question):
  Savol belgisi (?) bilan tugaydi.
  Yo so'roq so'zi bilan (Where ...?), yo 'be'/'do' bilan boshlanadi.

Epizodda AYNAN 7 ta buyruq va 6 ta savol bor.

items.whyUz: 'Help' — fe'l, egasi yo'q → buyruq gap.
DON'T + BE → buyruq gapning inkori.
'Swim' — fe'l asos shaklida → buyruq gap.
Bitta so'zli buyruq gap — favqulodda holatda ishlatiladi.
'Just' — yumshatuvchi so'z, buyruq gapni o'zgartirmaydi.
'put on' — frazali fe'l, buyruq shaklida.
DON'T + fe'l → buyruq gapning inkori.
'Where' so'roq so'zi + 'are' + ega.
'Are' bilan boshlanadi → ha/yo'q savoli.
'Where's' = Where IS.

items.answer: Well, David, are these the photographs of Nessie?
items.whyUz: 'are these ...?' — ko'plik ha/yo'q savoli.
Bitta so'zli savol — hayrat va tushunmovchilikni bildiradi.

items.answer: Where are the photographs of Nessie?
items.whyUz: 'Where' + 'are' + ko'plik ega ('the photographs').

exercises.instructionEn: Listen and follow the episode on p. 46. Finally, act out the episode.
exercises.instructionUz: Tinglang va 46-betdagi epizodni kuzatib boring. Nihoyat, epizodni sahnalashtiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
Uch rol bor: David, Sandra, Mike.
Har bir rolni ovoz ohangi bilan o'ynang:
  Sandra — qo'rqqan, qaltiragan ovoz
  David  — dadil, tinchlantiruvchi ovoz
  Mike   — hayron, keyin jahli chiqqan ovoz

example.speaker: Sandra
example.en: David! Where are you? Help me!

example.speaker: David
example.en: Don't be afraid Sandra. Swim fast!

example.speaker: Sandra
example.en: David! Help! I can't swim very well. The water's cold and I'm scared!
example.uz: Devid! Yordam! Yaxshi suza olmayman. Suv sovuq va qo'rqyapman!

example.speaker: David
example.en: It's all right Sandra. Just take my hand!
example.uz: Hammasi joyida, Sandra. Faqat qo'limdan ushla!

example.speaker: Sandra
example.en: Yes, David. Thank you. Brrr! I'm cold.

example.speaker: David
example.en: Don't worry. It's gone. We're safe now, and we've got photos of Nessie.
example.uz: Xavotir olma. U ketdi. Endi xavfsizmiz va bizda Nessining suratlari bor.

example.speaker: David
example.en: Hello Mike, David here. Bingo! I've got photos of the Loch Ness monster. It's amazing — it's huge! It's got a long neck and a small head. We've got a really great story.
example.uz: Salom Mayk, bu Devid. Zo'r! Menda Loch Ness maxlug'ining suratlari bor. Ajoyib — u ulkan! Uzun bo'yni va kichik boshi bor. Bizda haqiqatan zo'r maqola bor.

example.speaker: Mike
example.en: Well, David, are these the photographs of Nessie?

example.speaker: David
example.en: Yes, Mike. They're right here in this envelope!
example.uz: Ha, Mayk. Ular mana shu konvertda!

example.speaker: Mike
example.en: Hmmm! That's interesting ... So the monster has got blonde hair and big blue eyes! It's scared too!
example.uz: Hmmm! Qiziq ekan... Demak, maxluqning sariq sochi va katta ko'k ko'zlari bor ekan! U ham qo'rqib turibdi!

example.speaker: David
example.en: What?! Oh no! Where are the photographs of Nessie?

exercises.instructionEn: This is a summary of the two episodes. There are four mistakes in it. Read the text, find the mistakes and correct them.
exercises.instructionUz: Bu ikki epizodning qisqacha mazmuni. Unda to'rtta xato bor. Matnni o'qing, xatolarni toping va to'g'rilang.
exercises.explanationUz:
QISQACHA MAZMUN (xatolar bilan):

  In the offices of The Morning Sun, Mike, the editor, asks David
  and Sandra to write a story about the Loch Ness monster.
  David and Sandra go to the loch BY BUS. They hire a boat.
  David sees the monster and takes photographs of it.
  THE MONSTER IS SMALL. Sandra falls into the water and David
  saves her. David telephones Mike and tells him ABOUT THE
  ACCIDENT. Mike is happy because he thinks they have got
  photographs of the monster. Unfortunately, there is no monster
  in the photographs. They are all photographs of DAVID'S FACE.

O'ZBEKCHA TARJIMASI (to'g'rilangan holda):
  'The Morning Sun' gazetasi idorasida muharrir Mayk Devid va
  Sandradan Loch Ness maxlug'i haqida maqola yozishni so'raydi.
  Devid va Sandra ko'lga POYEZDDA borishadi. Ular qayiq ijaraga
  olishadi. Devid maxluqni ko'radi va uni suratga oladi.
  MAXLUQ ULKAN. Sandra suvga tushib ketadi va Devid uni
  qutqaradi. Devid Maykka telefon qilib, MAXLUQ VA SURATLAR
  haqida aytadi. Mayk xursand, chunki u ularda maxluqning
  suratlari bor deb o'ylaydi. Afsuski, suratlarda maxluq yo'q.
  Ularning hammasi SANDRANING yuzi surati.

DIQQAT: 'The Morning Sun' — TO'G'RI (1-epizodda ham shunday).

items.textEn: 1-XATO: "David and Sandra go to the loch by bus."
items.answer: They go to the loch by train.

items.hintUz: Devid telefonda maxluq haqida nima deydi?
items.whyUz:
Devid: 'It's amazing — it's HUGE!'
1-epizodda ham: 'Wow! It's huge!'
Faqat BOSHI kichik ('a small head'), o'zi esa ulkan.

items.textEn: 3-XATO: "David telephones Mike and tells him about the accident."
items.answer: David telephones Mike and tells him about the monster and the photographs.
items.whyUz:
Devid telefonda halokat haqida emas, MAXLUQ va SURATLAR haqida gapiradi:
'Bingo! I've got photos of the Loch Ness monster.'

items.textEn: 4-XATO: "They are all photographs of David's face."
items.answer: They are all photographs of Sandra's face.
items.whyUz:
Mayk: 'blonde hair and big blue eyes' — bu SANDRA.
Oxirgi rasmda ham Sandraning surati ko'rinadi.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the short text and fill in the gaps with words from the list. What is the name of the castle?
exercises.instructionUz: Qisqa matnni o'qing va bo'shliqlarni ro'yxatdagi so'zlar bilan to'ldiring. Qasrning nomi nima?
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT: lake, monster, long, dark, trees, visit

MATN (to'ldirilgan holda):
  Loch Ness is a big lake in Scotland. It is in the Scottish
  Highlands. It is twenty-three miles LONG and one mile wide.
  It's a very deep LAKE. The water is DARK and cold. People
  believe that a MONSTER lives in the waters of Loch Ness.
  They call this monster Nessie. There are many stories from
  people about Nessie. There are lots of TREES by the lake.
  There is also a castle called Urquhart Castle. A lot of
  tourists VISIT Loch Ness every year. They all hope to see Nessie.

O'ZBEKCHA TARJIMASI:
  Loch Ness — Shotlandiyadagi katta ko'l. U Shotlandiya
  tog'liklarida joylashgan. Uzunligi yigirma uch mil, eni bir mil.
  Bu juda chuqur ko'l. Suvi qorong'i va sovuq. Odamlar Loch Ness
  suvlarida maxluq yashaydi deb ishonishadi. Ular bu maxluqni
  Nessi deb atashadi. Odamlardan Nessi haqida ko'p hikoyalar bor.
  Ko'l bo'yida ko'p daraxtlar bor. Yana Urquhart Castle degan
  qasr ham bor. Har yili ko'p sayyohlar Loch Nessga tashrif
  buyuradi. Ularning hammasi Nessini ko'rishga umid qiladi.

QIZIQ FAKT: 'loch' — shotlandcha so'z, 'ko'l' degani.
Shuning uchun 'Loch Ness lake' deyish takror bo'ladi.

items.textEn: It is twenty-three miles 1) ............ and one mile wide.
items.whyUz:
'X miles LONG and Y miles WIDE' — uzunlik va en.
'a mile' = mil (taxminan 1,6 km).

'a lake' = ko'l. 'deep' = chuqur.
Loch Ness — Britaniyadagi eng chuqur ko'llardan.

'dark' = qorong'i, to'q. Torf tufayli suv qora ko'rinadi —
shuning uchun maxluqni ko'rish qiyin degan afsona bor.

items.textEn: People believe that a 4) ............ lives in the waters of Loch Ness.
items.whyUz:
'a monster' = maxluq. Keyingi gapda: 'They call this MONSTER Nessie.'
'believe that ...' = ...deb ishonmoq.

items.textEn: There are lots of 5) ............ by the lake.
items.whyUz:
'trees' = daraxtlar. 'lots of' = ko'p.
'by the lake' = ko'l bo'yida.

items.textEn: A lot of tourists 6) ............ Loch Ness every year.
items.whyUz:
'to visit' = tashrif buyurmoq.
Ko'plik ega ('tourists') → fe'lga -s QO'SHILMAYDI.

items.textEn: SAVOL: What is the name of the castle?
items.whyUz:
Matnda: 'There is also a castle called Urquhart Castle.'
Talaffuzi: /ˈɜːkət/ — 'orkat' (shotlandcha nom).
Rasmdagi vayrona qasr — aynan shu.

groups.explanationUz: ODAM o'zini qanday his qilishini bildiradi. 'be' fe'li bilan keladi.

patterns.exampleEn: Mike is surprised. Sandra is scared.
patterns.explanationUz: O'zbekchada fe'l bilan aytiladi, inglizchada 'be' + SIFAT.

patterns.formula: How does + ega + FEEL? — He/She feels + sifat.
patterns.exampleEn: How does Sandra feel? — She feels cold.
patterns.exampleUz: Sandra o'zini qanday his qilyapti? — U sovqotgan.
patterns.explanationUz: 'feel' dan keyin SIFAT keladi ('feels coldly' XATO).

patterns.exampleEn: No, it hasn't. The monster has got a small head.
patterns.exampleUz: Yo'q, unday emas. Maxluqning boshi kichik.
patterns.explanationUz:
Avval qisqa inkor, keyin to'g'ri ma'lumot.
'has got' → hasn't;  'is' → isn't.

patterns.exampleEn: cold ≠ warm,  long ≠ short,  small ≠ big
patterns.exampleUz: sovuq ≠ iliq, uzun ≠ kalta, kichik ≠ katta
patterns.explanationUz: Sifatlarni JUFT holda yodlash eng samarali usul.

patterns.exampleEn: It is twenty-three miles long and one mile wide.
patterns.exampleUz: Uzunligi yigirma uch mil, eni bir mil.

patterns.exampleEn: People believe that a monster lives in the waters of Loch Ness.
patterns.exampleUz: Odamlar Loch Ness suvlarida maxluq yashaydi deb ishonishadi.
Ular bu maxluqni Nessi deb atashadi.
